title_en: Tao Yi v. Beijing Metro Foundation Engineering Company — dispute over ownership of invention patent rights
keywords_en: civil; dispute over patent ownership; second instance; Beijing High People's Court; Beijing; natural person; legal person; Patent Law; distinction between service invention and non-service invention; determination of time of completion of invention; extent of utilization of the entity's material conditions; reversal; drilling and grouting pile forming method; foundation construction; service invention dispute; patent right; dispute over ownership of invention patent of engineering company
full_text_en:
Tao Yi v. Beijing Metro Foundation Engineering Company — dispute over ownership of invention patent

Plaintiff: Tao Yi, male, General Manager of China Building Underground Engineering Company.

Defendant: Beijing Metro Foundation Engineering Company.

Legal Representative: Lu Jiangxing, Manager.

On December 25, 1988, the Beijing Metro Foundation Engineering Company, on the ground that the plaintiff Tao Yi's "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" was a service invention, requested the Beijing Patent Administration to confirm the patent right for the invention of the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" as belonging to the defendant. On August 1, 1989, the Beijing Patent Administration confirmed that the invention of the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" was a service invention and that the patent right belonged to the Beijing Metro Foundation Engineering Company.

The plaintiff Tao Yi, dissatisfied with the confirmation by the Beijing Patent Administration, filed a lawsuit with the Beijing Intermediate People's Court on the ground that the completion of the technical scheme of the invention patent for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" was neither the execution of the tasks assigned by his unit nor the performance of his post duties, nor did it involve the use of the material conditions of his unit, requesting that the invention patent right be adjudicated as belonging to him personally. The defendant Beijing Metro Foundation Engineering Company argued in its defense that the invention patent for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" was completed by the plaintiff in the course of performing his duties, was the result of executing the scientific research and production tasks assigned by his superiors and his unit, and utilized the unit's funds, equipment, and technical materials. Therefore, the plaintiff's invention was a service invention and the patent right should belong to the defendant.

The Beijing Intermediate People's Court, in accordance with the litigation procedures stipulated in the Supreme People's Court's "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Conduct of Patent Trial Work," took the disputing parties at the time of the handling by the patent administration as the parties to the lawsuit. After a public trial, the court found the following:

In January 1983, the plaintiff Tao Yi was transferred from the position of Deputy Chief Engineer of the Sixth Detachment of the Capital Construction Engineering Corps of the People's Liberation Army to serve as the Factory Director of the Precast Component Factory of the Beijing Headquarters of the Capital Construction Engineering Corps. On July 1, 1983, the Capital Construction Engineering Corps of the People's Liberation Army was collectively transferred to civilian work, and Tao Yi's unit was renamed the Component Factory of Beijing Urban Construction Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the Component Factory), with Tao Yi still serving as Factory Director. On February 13, 1984, the Haidian District Administration for Industry and Commerce of Beijing approved the business scope of the Component Factory as building components. Around that time, due to poor business performance, the Component Factory, while mainly producing building components, also engaged in some foundation construction activities using "small pile technology." On April 2, 1984, the Beijing Urban Construction Corporation included "test and application of small pile technology" in the corporation's scientific research and technological innovation plan, assigned it to its subordinate Design Institute and the Component Factory, and allocated a scientific research subsidy of RMB 5,000. On April 16, 1984, Tao Yi, based on his many years of accumulated experience in foundation engineering construction at the Sixth Detachment of the Capital Construction Engineering Corps, completed the "scheme for forming holes and piles under geological conditions such as quicksand, groundwater, and hole collapse" (which later became the patent-applied "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method"), and recorded this technical scheme completely in his notebook that had been specially used for decades to record technical data. Although the technical scheme had not been tested, it already possessed the utility required by the Patent Law. Thereafter, Tao Yi repeatedly explained and demonstrated the technical scheme to several other leaders of the Component Factory. In June 1984, with approval from superiors, the Component Factory internally established the Beijing Great Wall Foundation Company, with Tao Yi concurrently serving as Manager. In September 1984, the foundation construction project for the Beijing Science and Technology Activity Center building encountered difficulties, and the commissioning unit asked Tao Yi for help. After Tao Yi, on behalf of the Component Factory, accepted this foundation construction project, and after five piles using small pile technology all failed, he explained to the commissioning unit the technical scheme he had already conceived, i.e., the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method," and the commissioning unit agreed to use this scheme. On January 15, 1985, in order to complete the foundation construction task undertaken according to Tao Yi's technical scheme, the Component Factory transported the Z400-type long spiral drilling rig purchased from Zhengzhou Survey and Prospecting Machinery Factory, Henan Province, to the construction site of the Beijing Science and Technology Activity Center building. In accordance with the national "Specifications for Design and Construction of Cast-in-place Pile Foundations for Industrial and Civil Buildings," which states that "test holes must be formed before construction, with a minimum of two holes," on March 16 and 17, 1985, the construction team of the Component Factory drilled two piles according to Tao Yi's technical scheme, which passed inspection completely. Tao Yi's technical scheme was successfully applied for the first time. Subsequently, the technical scheme was applied multiple times under conditions of confidentiality. On January 25, 1986, under repeated urging from several key leaders of the Component Factory, Tao Yi applied to the China Patent Office for a non-service invention patent for the technical scheme named "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method." In July 1986, the Component Factory expanded its business scope, adding the item "foundation treatment engineering." On October 3, 1986, the Beijing Great Wall Foundation Company separated from the Component Factory and was reorganized into the Beijing Metro Foundation Engineering Company (the current defendant, hereinafter referred to as the Foundation Company). Tao Yi served as the Manager of the Foundation Company. On February 11, 1988, Tao Yi obtained the non-service invention patent right for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method."

The Beijing Intermediate People's Court held that: Although the plaintiff Tao Yi, due to his long-term work in foundation construction, played a decisive role in conceiving and completing the patented technical content of the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method," during the testing process of the patented technology, he used equipment specifically purchased for this purpose by the defendant. Accordingly, on December 23, 1991, the court adjudicated: The invention patent right for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" shall be jointly owned by the plaintiff Tao Yi and the defendant Metro Foundation Engineering Company.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, the plaintiff Tao Yi, dissatisfied, appealed to the Beijing High People's Court on the grounds that the facts found in the judgment were basically accurate, but the conclusion contradicted the facts found, and the application of law was erroneous, requesting that the technical invention patent for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" be confirmed as a non-service invention and that the patent right belong to him personally. The defendant Foundation Company argued in its defense that the invention patent should be a service invention, on the grounds that: Tao Yi had long been engaged in the research and application of pile foundation construction technology, and from 1983, the Component Factory had undertaken a large number of pile foundation construction tasks, and the Beijing Urban Construction Corporation had also formally assigned scientific research tasks on pile foundation engineering to the Component Factory. Tao Yi, as Factory Director, had been presiding over the research, application, and promotion of pile foundation engineering. Therefore, Tao Yi's conception was formed in the course of performing his duties, and was generated under the conditions of tasks, environment, equipment, funds, and personnel provided by the unit.

The Beijing High People's Court held upon trial that: The "scheme for forming holes and piles under geological conditions such as quicksand, groundwater, and hole collapse" provided by the appellant Tao Yi is identical to the technical scheme for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" for which he later applied for a patent. The completion time of this technical scheme was April 16, 1984, which the appellant Foundation Company did not dispute. Based on the facts of this case, when determining the ownership of the invention patent right, the completion time of the technical scheme should be the boundary, to see whether it meets the requirements for a service invention as stipulated in the Patent Law.

First, at that time, Tao Yi, as the Factory Director of the Component Factory, had the scope of duties that should have been to lead and manage the production and business activities of building components. Foundation construction did not fall within the business scope of the Component Factory, and research and inventions related to foundation construction should not be considered the duties of the Factory Director of the Component Factory.

Second, the technical scheme of the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" was researched and developed by Tao Yi based on his many years of accumulated work experience in foundation engineering, and did not constitute a task assigned by his unit. On April 2, 1984, the specific scientific research task assigned by the Urban Construction Corporation to the Design Institute and the Component Factory was the "test and application of small pile technology," which involved promoting and applying the internationally existing small pile technology domestically, not researching new pile forming methods based on small pile technology. Compared with the existing "small pile technology," although both Tao Yi's invented "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" and the existing technology belong to technical schemes in the field of foundation construction, expert demonstration confirmed that there is an essential difference between the two technical schemes. Moreover, the fact that the China Patent Office, after substantive examination, granted the invention patent right for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" also indicates that this technical scheme is different from the existing technology and possesses patentability. These facts show that the scientific research task assigned by the Urban Construction Corporation is unrelated to the appellant's invention and does not fall under the circumstance of "executing the tasks of the unit" as stipulated in Article 6 of the Patent Law of the PRC and Article 10 of the Implementing Regulations of the Patent Law of the PRC.

Third, according to Article 6, paragraph 1 of the Patent Law, an invention-creation is considered a service invention-creation only when the inventor mainly utilized the material conditions of the unit to complete the invention. Tao Yi's technical scheme for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" was completed on April 16, 1984. In the process of completing the invention, Tao Yi mainly relied on his own accumulated experience in foundation engineering construction over several decades, and did not mainly utilize the material conditions of his unit. After the completion of Tao Yi's technical scheme, its first implementation was on March 16 and 17, 1985, at the Beijing Science and Technology Activity Center construction site. The two test piles drilled at that time, according to relevant national regulations, constituted necessary construction preparations for this project. Therefore, these two test piles were an implementation of the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" technical scheme, clearly different from testing a technical concept before the completion of the technical scheme. The funds for these two test piles were included in the total project cost, and no research funds were used. The Z400-type long spiral drilling rig used in the construction was purchased by Tao Yi, after the completion of his technical scheme, with approval for the purpose of implementing the technology to generate profits for the enterprise, and had nothing to do with the completion of the technical scheme.

In summary, the invention patent for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" is neither an invention-creation completed by Tao Yi in executing the tasks of his unit nor an invention-creation completed mainly by utilizing the material conditions of his unit. Therefore, it does not constitute a service invention-creation as defined in the Patent Law. Tao Yi's appeal is well-founded and should be supported. The judgment of the court of first instance, which adjudicated the invention patent right for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" as jointly owned by Tao Yi and the Foundation Company, lacks factual and legal basis and should be reversed. Accordingly, the Beijing High People's Court, in accordance with Article 153, paragraph 1, item (2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, on May 8, 1992, adjudicated as follows:

1. The civil judgment (1991) Zhong Jing Zi No. 724 of the Beijing Intermediate People's Court is set aside;

2. The invention patent right for the "borehole pressure grouting pile forming method" belongs to the appellant Tao Yi.
